title: Hoshino Ichika — A Picture Of Radiance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thank goodness I was able to finish my art project on time.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The teacher even praised me for “expressing what I felt in a very straightforward manner.”)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I really need to thank Miku and the others sometime...)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, hi, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You have your sketchbook with you...
Does that mean you just had art class?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we just got our projects back.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh! You drew a picture of Miku, right?
Can I see what kind of masterpiece you created?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, one second.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, it's Miku!
And she's so colorful! It's really pretty!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I decided to use a variety of colors to express the different ways in which Miku is radiant. But I still feel like I could've done a better job...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
This totally shows me how you see Miku, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really! She can be incredibly cool, adorably cute or super sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your drawing is a tidy package that's jam-packed with all of her best qualities!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I actually had Miku and some of the others help me with this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, she agreed to model for me.
We even all ended up drawing together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That really allowed me to complete my project.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It was really hard, but it was definitely worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Plus, Saki, you understood what I was trying to do in terms of how to present her radiance.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That was crystal clear!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And your project turned out so well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did get to see your progress along the way, but the end result was really beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
How gorgeous was Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Very. And I immediately understood what you were trying to do, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It struck me that basing the outfit off of Kanade's songs really brought her kindness to the surface.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I ended up causing her a lot of trouble because I took so long to arrive on the right answer...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm really glad that I kept trying until I was satisfied!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we both did our very best.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget...
I wanted your advice on something, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My advice?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to thank Miku and the others for helping me with my project.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Then, why don't you get them some yummy snacks?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can tell them how well your project went while having a little picnic together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a good idea...
I might stop by the store on my way home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure they'll love whatever you bring!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which!
I need to thank Kanade for helping me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do you think I should do for her, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Nothing too extravagant, since you don't want her to believe that she has to return the favor.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right. Hmm... This is really hard...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you'll figure something out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Ichi, you're not gonna help me?!
